{{Quote|If Kreuge had only swept farther with the right wing at Salvara instead of turning when he did, the whole history of the Clone Wars would be different!|An armchair historian|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] '''Kreuge''' served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Kreuge was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], and participated at the [[Battle of Salvara]]. However, [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] agents working within the Republic uploaded a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[virus]] to the ''[[Gibbon]]'', a prototype [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyer]] at [[Handooine/Legends|Handooine]]. The virus self-replicated and had spread to the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in Kreuge's [[Task force/Legends|task force]] during the battle. At a certain range,<ref name="Guide" /> as Kreuge turned his fleet's right wing instead of sweeping out further,<ref name="TRG1" /> the virus caused all the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] on the ship's throughout the fleet to drop. A potential victory for the Republic was turned into a defeat, but Kreuge survived. Shortly after the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], Kreuge commanded the Republic forces responsible for [[Battle of Kerkoidia|capturing]] [[Kerkoidia/Legends|Kerkoidia]]. Kerkoidia was still considered to be a Republic holding despite siding with the Separatists, and the planet's [[Grand Duke|grand dukes]] swiftly proclaimed their fealty to the Republic.<ref name="Guide" />

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Historian/Legends|historians]] would debate Kreuge's tactics at Salvara, and consider that had he continued sweeping to the right with his formation, rather than turning in, the outcome of the Clone Wars would have been very different.<ref name="TRG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
A nod to Admiral Kreuge<ref name="Twit">{{Twitter|jasoncfry|status/847108265125273602|[[Jason Fry]]|quote=@LelalMekha Yep, that's it.|archivefile=File:Admiral Kreuges revenge tweet.png}}</ref> appears in the [[canon]] novel ''[[The Weapon of a Jedi: A Luke Skywalker Adventure]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]]<ref name="Weapon of a Jedi">''[[The Weapon of a Jedi: A Luke Skywalker Adventure]]''</ref> and released on [[September 4]], [[2015]],<ref name="Hachette">{{HachetteBookGroup|url=titles/disney-book-group/star-wars-the-weapon-of-a-jedi/9781484724965|text=Star Wars: The Weapon Of A Jedi A Luke Skywalker Adventure}}</ref> in the form of the starship ''[[Kreuge's Revenge]]''.<ref name="Weapon of a Jedi" />
